<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#07131e">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="Narrabri SSAA Shoot Manager">
<title>Narrabri SSAA Shoot Manager</title>
<style>
:root{
--bg:#06111b;
--panel:#0b1b28;
--panel2:#0f2636;
--line:#244154;
--text:#f4f7fb;
--muted:#a7b7c6;
--blue:#1685ff;
--blue2:#0768d7;
--green:#0c9a63;
--yellow:#ffd21a;
--red:#c54848;
--shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#06111b,#071724 48%,#06111b);color:var(--text);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
body{min-height:100vh}
button,input,select{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer}
.hidden{display:none!important}
/* APP BAR */
.appbar{
position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
padding:12px 18px;
background:rgba(5,17,27,.96);
border-bottom:1px solid #173145;
backdrop-filter:blur(12px)
}
.brand-logo{width:54px;height:54px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;flex:none}
.brand{min-width:230px}
.brand h1{margin:0;font-size:21px;letter-spacing:.1px}
.brand p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.topnav{display:flex;gap:5px;overflow:auto;margin-left:auto}
.topnav button{
min-width:78px;border:0;background:transparent;color:#c8d6e1;
padding:8px 10px 10px;border-radius:12px;font-weight:700;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px
}
.topnav button .ico{font-size:21px;line-height:1}
.topnav button.active{color:#fff;background:#0c2232;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 var(--blue)}
.topnav button:hover{background:#0c2232}
/* LAYOUT */
main{max-width:1260px;margin:auto;padding:0 18px 26px}
.tab{padding-top:18px}
.card{
background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(17,39,55,.96),rgba(9,25,37,.96));
border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;
box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.section-card{padding:18px;margin-bottom:16px}
h2,h3{margin-top:0}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:12px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px}
label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#bdd0de;margin-bottom:6px}
input,select{
width:100%;padding:12px 13px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #35536a;
background:#081721;color:#fff;outline:none
}
input:focus,select:focus{border-color:var(--blue);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #1685ff30}
.actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:13px}
.btn-primary,.btn-secondary,.btn-danger{
border-radius:10px;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:800;border:1px solid transparent
}
.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--blue),var(--blue2));color:#fff}
.btn-secondary{background:#142d3f;color:#eef6fb;border-color:#36566e}
.btn-danger{background:#6f2328;color:#fff;border-color:#a5454c}
.pill{display:inline-block;background:#142d3f;border:1px solid #36566e;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 9px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.good{background:#0c7c54}.warn{background:#0b67c8}
/* HOME */
.hero{
margin:0 -18px 18px;
min-height:390px;
position:relative;overflow:hidden;
border-bottom:1px solid #183248;
display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;
background:
radial-gradient(circle at 75% 30%,rgba(255,181,74,.28),transparent 25%),
radial-gradient(circle at 30% 35%,rgba(22,133,255,.12),transparent 30%),
linear-gradient(180deg,#17334a 0%,#10283b 40%,#071520 100%)
}
.hero:before{
content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
background:
linear-gradient(160deg,transparent 0 55%,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 55% 56%,transparent 56%),
linear-gradient(20deg,transparent 0 62%,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 62% 63%,transparent 63%);
opacity:.8
}
.hero-inner{
position:relative;z-index:1;text-align:center;
padding:34px 20px 28px;max-width:900px;width:100%
}
.hero-logo{width:185px;height:185px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 34px #0008;margin-bottom:8px}
.hero h2{font-size:42px;line-height:1.05;margin:4px 0 8px}
.hero p{font-size:20px;margin:0;color:#dbe7ef}
.hero-rule{width:180px;height:5px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--yellow);margin:16px auto 0}
.quick-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.quick{
min-height:160px;padding:22px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #315069;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#122b3d,#0b1c29);
color:#fff;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow)
}
.quick.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0f8dff,#075ec7);border-color:#1b87f3}
.quick .qico{font-size:42px;margin-bottom:13px}
.quick h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:20px}
.quick p{margin:0;color:#b9c8d4;font-size:14px}
.quick.primary p{color:#dcecff}
.recent{overflow:hidden}
.recent-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:17px 19px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.recent-head h3{margin:0}
.tablewrap{overflow:auto}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:760px}
th,td{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #1c3648;text-align:left;vertical-align:middle}
th{font-size:13px;color:#c5d4de;background:#0b1c29}
td{color:#eef5fa}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:26px;color:var(--muted)}
.footer-note{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:22px 2px 6px;color:#a7b7c6;font-size:13px}
/* DATA SECTIONS */
.detail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}
.score-summary{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:14px}
.bigscore{font-size:29px}
.rulebox{background:#081721;border:1px solid #25455c;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.48;color:#bfd0dd}
.targetcard{background:#0a1a26;border:1px solid #29485f;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;margin:10px 0}
.targethead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:9px}
.bullgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(60px,1fr));gap:7px}
.bull{background:#0d2231;border:1px solid #2e4f65;border-radius:10px;padding:6px}
.bull label{text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px}
.bull select{padding:8px 4px}
.groupinput{width:92px!important;padding:9px!important}
.nav-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.nav-card{padding:18px;border:1px solid #2b4a60;border-radius:14px;background:#0c1e2b}
.nav-card h3{margin:0 0 6px}
.nav-card p{margin:0;color:#9fb2c1}
/* BENCH DRAW */
.draw-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:16px}
.draw-number{font-size:32px;font-weight:900}
.draw-detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:12px}
.draw-detail{padding:14px;border:1px solid #2b4a60;border-radius:14px;background:#0a1d2a}
.draw-detail h3{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 10px}
.draw-list{display:grid;gap:7px}
.draw-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 9px;border-radius:10px;background:#0d2636;border:1px solid #29475c}
.draw-bench{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;text-align:center}
.unassigned{color:#ffd21a;font-weight:800}
@media(max-width:700px){.draw-hero{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
/* SETTINGS */
.settings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2fr 1fr;gap:16px}
/* MOBILE */
@media(max-width:900px){
.appbar{align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{min-width:0;flex:1}
.topnav{order:3;width:100%;margin-left:0}
.hero{min-height:330px}
.hero h2{font-size:34px}
.quick-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.settings-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
main{padding:0 10px 20px}.tab{padding-top:10px}
.appbar{padding:10px}.brand-logo{width:46px;height:46px}.brand h1{font-size:17px}.brand p{font-size:11px}
.topnav button{min-width:66px;padding:7px 8px;font-size:12px}
.hero{margin:0 -10px 14px;min-height:285px}.hero-logo{width:130px;height:130px}.hero h2{font-size:27px}.hero p{font-size:15px}
.quick-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}.quick{min-height:135px;padding:16px}.quick .qico{font-size:34px}.quick h3{font-size:16px}
.section-card{padding:14px}.bullgrid{gap:4px}.bull{padding:4px}.bull select{font-size:14px;padding:7px 2px}
.footer-note{flex-direction:column}
}
@media print{.appbar,.actions,.quick-grid,.footer-note{display:none!important}.card{box-shadow:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

</section>
<section id="details" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<div class="detail-head"><div><h2>Details</h2><p class="muted">Create unlimited details and see exactly who is on each bench.</p></div><span class="pill" id="detailPill">0 Details</span></div>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Detail name / number</label><input id="newDetailName" placeholder="Detail 1"></div>
</div>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-primary" onclick="addDetail()">＋ Add Detail</button></div>
</div>
<div id="detailList"></div>
</section>
<section id="shooters" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Add Shooter</h2><p class="muted">For a random bench draw, leave the shooter in <b>Bench Draw Pool (unassigned)</b>. Add everyone first, then run the draw.</p>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Name</label><input id="sName" placeholder="Shooter name"></div>
<div><label>Assignment</label><select id="sDetail"></select></div>
<div><label>Bench Number</label><input id="sBench" type="number" min="1" placeholder="Leave blank for bench draw"></div>
<div><label>Category</label><select id="sCategory"></select></div>
</div>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-primary" onclick="addShooter()">＋ Add Shooter</button><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="go('benchdraw')">🎲 Go to Bench Draw</button></div>
</div>
<div class="card section-card"><h2>All Shooters</h2><div id="shooterTable"></div></div>
</section>
<section id="benchdraw" class="tab hidden">
<div class="draw-hero">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>🎲 Bench Draw</h2>
<p class="muted">Choose how many benches are available in each detail. Add all shooters first, then the app randomly assigns unique bench numbers. Detail 1 is filled first, then Detail 2, Detail 3 and so on.</p>
<div class="grid">
<div>
<label>Benches available per detail</label>
<input id="benchCount" type="number" min="1" max="100" inputmode="numeric" value="10" onchange="saveBenchCount(this.value)">
</div>
</div>
<div class="actions">
<button class="btn-secondary" onclick="go('shooters')">＋ Add Shooters</button>
<button class="btn-primary" onclick="runBenchDraw()">🎲 Run Bench Draw</button>
<button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearBenchDraw()">Clear Draw</button>
</div>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin-top:12px">
Running the draw reassigns <b>all shooters in the current match</b>. Each detail gets benches 1 to the number you choose, with no duplicate bench number inside a detail. If the last detail is not full, it simply contains the remaining shooters.
</div>
</div>
<div class="card section-card">
<h3>Draw Summary</h3>
<div class="grid">
<div><div class="draw-number" id="drawShooterCount">0</div><div class="muted">Shooters</div></div>
<div><div class="draw-number" id="drawBenchCount">0</div><div class="muted">Benches / detail</div></div>
<div><div class="draw-number" id="drawDetailCount">0</div><div class="muted">Details needed</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="benchDrawResult"></div>
</section>
<section id="score" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Benchrest for Score</h2>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Firearm / Discipline</label><select id="scoreDiscipline" onchange="scoreDisciplineChanged()"><option>Rimfire</option><option>Centrefire</option></select></div>
<div><label>Category</label><select id="scoreClass" onchange="populateScoreShooters()"></select></div>
<div><label>Distance</label><select id="scoreDistance" onchange="renderScore()"></select></div>
<div><label>Cards being shot today</label>
<select id="scoreCardsToday" onchange="setScoreCardsToday(this.value)">
<option value="1">1 card</option>
<option value="2">2 cards</option>
<option value="3">3 cards</option>
<option value="4">4 cards</option>
<option value="5">5 cards</option>
</select>
</div>
<div><label>Detail</label><select id="scoreDetail" onchange="populateScoreShooters()"></select></div>
<div><label>Shooter</label><select id="scoreShooter" onchange="renderScore()"></select></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox">Choose how many score cards are being shot today. Only that many Target cards are shown and counted. Rimfire and Centrefire are both available, with Custom, Heavy, Light, Sporter, Juniors and Ladies categories.</div>
</div>
<div id="scoreEntry"></div>
</section>
<section id="group" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Benchrest Group</h2>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Discipline</label><select id="groupDiscipline" onchange="groupDisciplineChanged()"><option>Rimfire</option><option>Centrefire</option></select></div>
<div><label>Category</label><select id="groupCategory" onchange="renderGroup()"></select></div>
<div><label>Class</label><select id="groupClass" onchange="renderGroup()"></select></div>
<div><label>Distance</label><select id="groupDistance" onchange="renderGroup()"></select></div>
<div><label>Cards being shot today</label>
<select id="groupCardsToday" onchange="setGroupCardsToday(this.value)">
<option value="1">1 card</option>
<option value="2">2 cards</option>
<option value="3">3 cards</option>
<option value="4">4 cards</option>
<option value="5">5 cards</option>
</select>
</div>
<div><label>Detail</label><select id="groupDetail" onchange="renderGroup()"></select></div>
</div>
<div class="rulebox">Choose the shooter <b>Category</b> and how many Group cards are being shot today. Only that many groups are shown and counted. The <b>Total Agg</b> is calculated as soon as every Group card selected for today has a measurement. If you choose 3 cards, Groups 1–3 make the Total Agg and Groups 4–5 are ignored.</div>
</div>
<div id="groupTable"></div>
</section>
<section id="irb" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>International Rimfire Benchrest (IRB)</h2>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Category</label><select id="irbCategory" onchange="populateIRBShooters()"></select></div>
<div><label>Detail</label><select id="irbDetail" onchange="populateIRBShooters()"></select></div>
<div><label>Shooter</label><select id="irbShooter" onchange="renderIRB()"></select></div>
<div><label>Card</label><select id="irbTarget" onchange="renderIRB()"></select></div>
<div><label>Cards being shot today</label>
<select id="irbCardsToday" onchange="setIRBCardsToday(this.value)">
<option value="1">1 card</option>
<option value="2">2 cards</option>
<option value="3">3 cards</option>
<option value="4">4 cards</option>
<option value="5">5 cards</option>
<option value="6">6 cards</option>
</select>
</div>
</div>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="previousIRB()">← Previous</button><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="nextIRB()">Next →</button></div>
<div class="rulebox">Choose the shooter <b>Category</b> first. 50m • 25 record rondels per card • 20 minutes per card. Best-edge scoring applies. X counts 10 points plus one X. Choose how many cards are being shot today and the totals/results adjust automatically.</div>
</div>
<div class="card section-card">
<div class="score-summary"><span id="irbTitle"></span><span class="bigscore" id="irbScore"></span><span id="irbX"></span></div>
<div class="bullgrid" id="irbGrid"></div>
<div class="grid" style="margin-top:12px"><div><label>Penalty points</label><input id="irbPenalty" type="number" min="0" value="0" onchange="updateIRBPenalty(this.value)"></div></div>
</div>
<div class="card section-card"><h3>IRB Day Summary</h3><div id="irbSummary"></div></div>
</section>
<section id="results" class="tab hidden">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Results</h2>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin-bottom:12px">
<b>Group Total Aggregate</b> uses all Group cards selected for today. If you choose 3 cards, it uses Group 1, Group 2 and Group 3 only. The app calculates the Total Aggregate automatically. Lowest Total Aggregate wins.
</div>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Match Type</label><select id="resultType" onchange="resultTypeChanged()"><option value="score">Benchrest for Score</option><option value="scoregrand">Score Grand Total (2 distances)</option><option value="group">Group</option><option value="grand">Group Total Aggregate (selected cards)</option><option value="irb">IRB</option></select></div>
<div id="resultDisciplineWrap"><label>Discipline</label><select id="resultDiscipline" onchange="resultDisciplineChanged()"><option>Rimfire</option><option>Centrefire</option></select></div>
<div id="resultCategoryWrap" class="hidden"><label>Category</label><select id="resultCategory" onchange="renderResults()"></select></div>
<div id="resultClassWrap"><label id="resultClassLabel">Category</label><select id="resultClass" onchange="renderResults()"></select></div>
<div id="resultDistanceWrap"><label>Distance</label><select id="resultDistance" onchange="renderResults()"></select></div>
<div><label>Detail</label><select id="resultDetail" onchange="renderResults()"></select></div>
</div>
</div>
<div id="resultsTable"></div>
<div class="card section-card">
<h3>Finish Match</h3>
<p class="muted">When the match is finished, this clears all shooters, details, bench numbers and scores so the next match starts empty.</p>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-danger" onclick="newShoot()">Finish Match & Start New</button></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="settings" class="tab hidden">
<div class="settings-grid">
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Shoot Settings</h2>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin-bottom:12px">Shooters belong to the current match only. When you press <b>Clear Match & Start New</b>, all shooters, details, bench numbers and results are removed.</div>
<div class="grid">
<div><label>Club / Venue</label><input id="club" placeholder="Narrabri"></div>
<div><label>Shoot Name</label><input id="shootName" placeholder="Narrabri Club Shoot"></div>
<div><label>Shoot Date</label><input id="date" type="date"></div>
</div>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-primary" onclick="saveSetup()">Save Shoot</button><button class="btn-danger" onclick="newShoot()">Clear Match & Start New</button></div>
</div>
<div class="card section-card">
<h2>Backup</h2>
<p class="muted">Keep a copy of the shoot data or move it to another device.</p>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="exportData()">Export Data</button><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="document.getElementById('importFile').click()">Import Data</button><input id="importFile" hidden type="file" accept="application/json" onchange="importData(this)"></div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</main>
<script>
const CATEGORIES=["Custom","Heavy","Light","Sporter","Juniors","Ladies"];
const SCORE_CLASSES={
Rimfire:[...CATEGORIES],
Centrefire:[...CATEGORIES]
};
const SCORE_DISTANCES={Rimfire:["50 metres","100 yards"],Centrefire:["100 yards","200 yards"]};
const GROUP_CLASSES={
Rimfire:[".22LR Light Rimfire Benchrest",".22LR Heavy Rimfire Benchrest"],
Centrefire:["Sporter Benchrest","Light Benchrest","Heavy Benchrest","Experimental / Unlimited Benchrest"]
};
const GROUP_DISTANCES={Rimfire:["50 metres","100 yards"],Centrefire:["100 yards","200 yards","300 yards"]};
const STORAGE="narrabriSSAA_dark_v18";
const OLD_KEYS=["narrabriSSAA_dark_v17","narrabriSSAA_dark_v16","narrabriSSAA_dark_v15","narrabriSSAA_dark_v14","narrabriSSAA_dark_v13","narrabriSSAA_dark_v12","narrabriSSAA_dark_v11","narrabriSSAA_dark_v10","narrabriSSAA_dark_v9","narrabriSSAA_dark_v8","narrabriSSAA_dark_v7","narrabriSSAA_dark_v6","narrabriSSAA_rulebook_v5","narrabriSSAA_v4","narrabriSSAA_v3","narrabriSSAA"];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
function freshDB(clubName="Narrabri"){return {club:clubName||"Narrabri",shootName:"Narrabri Club Shoot",date:"",details:[],shooters:[],score:{},group:{},irb:{},scoreCardsToday:5,groupCardsToday:5,irbTargets:3,irbCardsToday:3,benchCount:10}}
function normalize(x){
x.club=x.club||"Narrabri";x.shootName=x.shootName||"Narrabri Club Shoot";x.date=x.date||"";
x.details=Array.isArray(x.details)?x.details:[];x.shooters=Array.isArray(x.shooters)?x.shooters:[];x.shooters=x.shooters.map(s=>({...s,category:CATEGORIES.includes(s.category)?s.category:"Custom"}));
x.score=x.score||{};x.group=x.group||{};x.irb=x.irb||{};x.scoreCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(x.scoreCardsToday)||5));x.groupCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(x.groupCardsToday)||5));x.irbCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(6,Number(x.irbCardsToday||x.irbTargets)||3));x.irbTargets=x.irbCardsToday;x.benchCount=Math.max(1,Number(x.benchCount)||10);return x
}
function loadDB(){
try{let x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE)||"null");if(x)return normalize(x)}catch(e){}
for(const key of OLD_KEYS){
try{
let old=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||"null");
if(old){
let n=freshDB();n.club=old.club||"Narrabri";n.shootName=old.shootName||"Narrabri Club Shoot";n.date=old.date||"";n.details=old.details||[];n.shooters=(old.shooters||[]).map(s=>({id:s.id,name:s.name,detailId:s.detailId,bench:s.bench,category:CATEGORIES.includes(s.category)?s.category:"Custom"}));
n.score=old.score||{};n.group=old.group||{};n.irb=old.irb||{};n.irbTargets=old.irbTargets||3;return normalize(n)
}
}catch(e){}
}
return freshDB()
}
let db=loadDB();
function save(){localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(db));updateStats();renderRecent()}
function esc(s){return String(s??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[c]))}
function detailName(id){if(id==="unassigned"||!id)return "Bench Draw Pool";return db.details.find(d=>d.id===id)?.name||"Unknown"}
function setOpts(id,vals){let e=$(id),old=e.value;e.innerHTML=vals.map(v=>`<option>${esc(v)}</option>`).join("");e.value=vals.includes(old)?old:(vals[0]||"")}
function setDetails(id){let e=$(id),old=e.value,opts=db.details.map(d=>`<option value="${d.id}">${esc(d.name)}</option>`).join("");e.innerHTML='<option value="all">All Details</option>'+opts;e.value=[...e.options].some(o=>o.value===old)?old:"all"}
function saveSetup(){db.club=$("club").value.trim()||"Narrabri";db.shootName=$("shootName").value.trim()||"Narrabri Club Shoot";db.date=$("date").value;save();alert("Shoot saved.")}
function newShoot(){
const clubToKeep=db.club||"Narrabri"; const benchCountToKeep=Math.max(1,Number(db.benchCount)||10);
if(!confirm("Start a new match? This will remove ALL shooters, details, bench numbers, scores, group results and IRB cards from the current match."))return;
db=freshDB(clubToKeep); db.benchCount=benchCountToKeep;
localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(db));
renderAll();
go("settings");
alert("New match ready. All shooters and results from the previous match have been cleared.");
}
/* DETAILS + SHOOTERS */
function addDetail(){let name=$("newDetailName").value.trim()||`Detail ${db.details.length+1}`;db.details.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),name});$("newDetailName").value="";save();renderAll()}
function deleteDetail(id){if(db.shooters.some(s=>s.detailId===id))return alert("Remove or move shooters from this detail first.");db.details=db.details.filter(d=>d.id!==id);save();renderAll()}
function nextBench(detailId){let used=db.shooters.filter(s=>s.detailId===detailId).map(s=>Number(s.bench)),n=1;while(used.includes(n))n++;return n}
function addShooter(){
let name=$("sName").value.trim(),detailId=$("sDetail").value||"unassigned",bench=Number($("sBench").value),category=$("sCategory").value||"Custom";
if(!name)return alert("Enter a shooter name.");
if(detailId==="unassigned"){
bench=0;
}else{
if(!bench)bench=nextBench(detailId);
if(db.shooters.some(s=>s.detailId===detailId&&Number(s.bench)===bench))return alert("That bench is already used in this detail.");
}
db.shooters.push({id:crypto.randomUUID(),name,detailId,bench,category});
$("sName").value="";$("sBench").value="";save();renderAll()
}
function removeShooter(id){if(!confirm("Remove this shooter?"))return;db.shooters=db.shooters.filter(s=>s.id!==id);Object.keys(db.score).filter(k=>k.endsWith("||"+id)).forEach(k=>delete db.score[k]);Object.keys(db.group).filter(k=>k.endsWith("||"+id)).forEach(k=>delete db.group[k]);delete db.irb[id];save();renderAll()}
function updateShooterCategory(id,category){let s=db.shooters.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s)return;s.category=category;save();renderAll()}
function renderDetails(){
$("detailPill").textContent=`${db.details.length} Detail${db.details.length===1?"":"s"}`;
$("detailList").innerHTML=db.details.length?db.details.map(d=>{let ss=db.shooters.filter(s=>s.detailId===d.id).sort((a,b)=>a.bench-b.bench);return `<div class="card section-card"><div class="detail-head"><div><h3>${esc(d.name)}</h3><span class="pill">${ss.length} shooter${ss.length===1?"":"s"}</span></div><button class="btn-danger" onclick="deleteDetail('${d.id}')">Delete</button></div><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Bench</th><th>Shooter</th><th>Category</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${ss.map(s=>`<tr><td class="bench">${s.bench}</td><td>${esc(s.name)}</td><td>${esc(s.category||"Custom")}</td><td><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="removeShooter('${s.id}')">Remove</button></td></tr>`).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty">No shooters.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`}).join(""):'<div class="card section-card empty">No details yet.</div>'
}
function renderShooters(){$("shooterTable").innerHTML=db.shooters.length?`<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th><th>Category</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${db.shooters.slice().sort((a,b)=>detailName(a.detailId).localeCompare(detailName(b.detailId))||a.bench-b.bench).map(s=>`<tr><td>${esc(detailName(s.detailId))}</td><td class="bench">${s.bench? s.bench : "—"}</td><td>${esc(s.name)}</td><td><select onchange="updateShooterCategory('${s.id}',this.value)">${CATEGORIES.map(c=>`<option ${c===(s.category||"Custom")?"selected":""}>${c}</option>`).join("")}</select></td><td><button class="btn-danger" onclick="removeShooter('${s.id}')">Remove</button></td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div>`:'<div class="empty">No shooters yet.</div>'}
/* BENCH DRAW */
function saveBenchCount(v){
db.benchCount=Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number(v)||1));
save();
renderBenchDraw();
}
function shuffleArray(arr){
let a=arr.slice();
for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));
[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];
}
return a;
}
function runBenchDraw(){
const benches=Math.max(1,Math.min(100,Number($("benchCount").value)||db.benchCount||10));
if(!db.shooters.length)return alert("Add shooters before running the bench draw.");
if(!confirm(`Randomly draw ${db.shooters.length} shooters across ${benches} benches per detail? This will replace their current detail and bench assignments.`))return;
db.benchCount=benches;
const needed=Math.ceil(db.shooters.length/benches);
db.details=Array.from({length:needed},(_,i)=>({id:crypto.randomUUID(),name:`Detail ${i+1}`}));
const shooterOrder=shuffleArray(db.shooters);
let cursor=0;
for(let d=0;d<needed;d++){
const slots=Math.min(benches,db.shooters.length-cursor);
const benchNumbers=shuffleArray(Array.from({length:benches},(_,i)=>i+1)).slice(0,slots);
for(let i=0;i<slots;i++){
const shooter=shooterOrder[cursor++];
shooter.detailId=db.details[d].id;
shooter.bench=benchNumbers[i];
}
}
save();
renderAll();
go("benchdraw");
}
function clearBenchDraw(){
if(!db.shooters.length)return;
if(!confirm("Clear all detail and bench assignments and put every shooter back into the Bench Draw Pool?"))return;
db.details=[];
for(const s of db.shooters){s.detailId="unassigned";s.bench=0}
save();renderAll();go("benchdraw");
}
function renderBenchDraw(){
const benches=Math.max(1,Number(db.benchCount)||10);
if($("benchCount"))$("benchCount").value=benches;
if($("drawShooterCount"))$("drawShooterCount").textContent=db.shooters.length;
if($("drawBenchCount"))$("drawBenchCount").textContent=benches;
if($("drawDetailCount"))$("drawDetailCount").textContent=db.shooters.length?Math.ceil(db.shooters.length/benches):0;
if(!$("benchDrawResult"))return;
const assigned=db.shooters.filter(s=>s.detailId&&s.detailId!=="unassigned"&&s.bench);
const pool=db.shooters.filter(s=>!s.detailId||s.detailId==="unassigned"||!s.bench);
let cards=db.details.map(d=>{
const ss=db.shooters.filter(s=>s.detailId===d.id).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.bench)-Number(b.bench));
return `<div class="draw-detail">
<h3><span>${esc(d.name)}</span><span class="pill">${ss.length}/${benches}</span></h3>
<div class="draw-list">
${ss.map(s=>`<div class="draw-row"><div class="draw-bench">#${s.bench}</div><div><b>${esc(s.name)}</b><div class="small muted">${esc(s.category||"Custom")}</div></div><span class="pill">${esc(s.category||"Custom")}</span></div>`).join("")||'<div class="empty">No shooters</div>'}
</div>
</div>`
}).join("");
const poolCard=pool.length?`<div class="card section-card">
<h3>Bench Draw Pool <span class="pill">${pool.length}</span></h3>
<p class="muted">These shooters have not been drawn yet.</p>
<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Shooter</th><th>Category</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${pool.map(s=>`<tr><td>${esc(s.name)}</td><td>${esc(s.category||"Custom")}</td></tr>`).join("")}
</tbody></table></div>
</div>`:"";
$("benchDrawResult").innerHTML=poolCard+(cards?`<div class="card section-card"><div class="detail-head"><div><h2>Bench Draw Result</h2><p class="muted">${assigned.length} shooter${assigned.length===1?"":"s"} assigned.</p></div><button class="btn-primary" onclick="runBenchDraw()">🎲 Re-draw</button></div><div class="draw-detail-grid">${cards}</div></div>`:'<div class="card section-card empty">Add shooters, choose the number of benches, then run the draw.</div>');
}
/* SCORE */
function scoreKey(discipline,cls,distance,shooterId){return `${discipline}||${cls}||${distance}||${shooterId}`}
function scoreCard(discipline,cls,distance,shooterId){
let k=scoreKey(discipline,cls,distance,shooterId);
if(!db.score[k])db.score[k]={targets:Array.from({length:5},()=>({bulls:Array(5).fill(null),penalty:0}))};
let c=db.score[k];while(c.targets.length<5)c.targets.push({bulls:Array(5).fill(null),penalty:0});c.targets=c.targets.slice(0,5);
for(let t of c.targets){if(!Array.isArray(t.bulls))t.bulls=Array(5).fill(null);while(t.bulls.length<5)t.bulls.push(null);t.bulls=t.bulls.slice(0,5);t.penalty=Number(t.penalty||0)}
return c
}
function scoreParse(v){if(v==="X")return {points:10,x:1};if(v===null||v==="")return {points:null,x:0};return {points:Number(v),x:0}}
function scoreStats(card,count=db.scoreCardsToday||5){let points=0,x=0,counts={10:0,9:0,8:0,7:0,6:0},sequence=[],complete=true;let targets=card.targets.slice(0,Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(count)||5)));for(const t of targets){let tp=0,tx=0,filled=0;for(const v of t.bulls){let p=scoreParse(v);sequence.push(p.points===null?-1:p.points+(p.x?.1:0));if(p.points!==null){tp+=p.points;tx+=p.x;filled++;if(p.points>=6)counts[p.points]=(counts[p.points]||0)+1}}tp=Math.max(0,tp-Number(t.penalty||0));points+=tp;x+=tx;complete=complete&&filled===5}return {points,x,counts,sequence,complete}}
function scoreOptions(v){return ["","X","10","9","8","7","6","0"].map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${String(v??"")===x?"selected":""}>${x||"—"}</option>`).join("")}
function setScoreCardsToday(v){
db.scoreCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(v)||5));
save();
renderScore();
renderResults();
}
function scoreDisciplineChanged(){setOpts("scoreClass",SCORE_CLASSES[$("scoreDiscipline").value]);setOpts("scoreDistance",SCORE_DISTANCES[$("scoreDiscipline").value]);populateScoreShooters()}
function populateScoreShooters(){let detail=$("scoreDetail").value,category=$("scoreClass").value,shooters=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category).sort((a,b)=>detailName(a.detailId).localeCompare(detailName(b.detailId))||a.bench-b.bench),e=$("scoreShooter"),old=e.value;e.innerHTML=shooters.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">Bench ${s.bench} — ${esc(s.name)}</option>`).join("")||'<option value="">No shooters</option>';if(shooters.some(s=>s.id===old))e.value=old;renderScore()}
function updateScoreBull(t,b,v){let id=$("scoreShooter").value;if(!id)return;scoreCard($("scoreDiscipline").value,$("scoreClass").value,$("scoreDistance").value,id).targets[t].bulls[b]=v===""?null:v;save();renderScore();renderResults()}
function updateScorePenalty(t,v){let id=$("scoreShooter").value;if(!id)return;scoreCard($("scoreDiscipline").value,$("scoreClass").value,$("scoreDistance").value,id).targets[t].penalty=Math.max(0,Number(v)||0);save();renderScore();renderResults()}
function renderScore(){
const cardCount=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(db.scoreCardsToday)||5));
if($("scoreCardsToday"))$("scoreCardsToday").value=String(cardCount);
let id=$("scoreShooter").value;if(!id){$("scoreEntry").innerHTML='<div class="card section-card empty">Add/select a shooter.</div>';return}
let c=scoreCard($("scoreDiscipline").value,$("scoreClass").value,$("scoreDistance").value,id),st=scoreStats(c,cardCount);
$("scoreEntry").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card"><div class="score-summary"><span class="bigscore">${st.points}/${cardCount*50}</span><span>${st.x}/${cardCount*5} X</span><span class="pill ${st.complete?"good":"warn"}">${st.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</span></div></div>`+
c.targets.slice(0,cardCount).map((t,ti)=>{let ts=scoreStats({targets:[t]},1);return `<div class="targetcard"><div class="targethead"><b>Target ${ti+1}</b><span>${ts.points}/50 • ${ts.x}/5 X</span></div><div class="bullgrid">${t.bulls.map((v,bi)=>`<div class="bull"><label>Bull ${bi+1}</label><select onchange="updateScoreBull(${ti},${bi},this.value)">${scoreOptions(v)}</select></div>`).join("")}</div><div class="grid" style="margin-top:9px"><div><label>Target penalty points</label><input type="number" min="0" value="${t.penalty||0}" onchange="updateScorePenalty(${ti},this.value)"></div></div></div>`}).join("")
}
/* GROUP */
function groupKey(discipline,cls,distance,shooterId){return `${discipline}||${cls}||${distance}||${shooterId}`}
function groupCard(discipline,cls,distance,id){let k=groupKey(discipline,cls,distance,id);if(!db.group[k])db.group[k]={groups:Array(5).fill(null),moaPenalty:Array(5).fill(0)};let c=db.group[k];while(c.groups.length<5)c.groups.push(null);while(c.moaPenalty.length<5)c.moaPenalty.push(0);return c}
function groupAgg(distance,c,count=db.groupCardsToday||5){let n=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(count)||5));if(c.groups.slice(0,n).some(v=>v===null||v===""))return null;let scale={"50 metres":0.5,"100 yards":1,"200 yards":2,"300 yards":3}[distance]||1;let adjusted=c.groups.slice(0,n).map((v,i)=>Number(v)+(Number(c.moaPenalty[i]||0)*scale));let sum=adjusted.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0);if(distance==="50 metres")return sum*2/n;if(distance==="100 yards")return sum/n;if(distance==="200 yards")return sum/(2*n);if(distance==="300 yards")return sum/(3*n);return null}
function setGroupCardsToday(v){
db.groupCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(v)||5));
save();
renderGroup();
renderResults();
}
function groupDisciplineChanged(){setOpts("groupClass",GROUP_CLASSES[$("groupDiscipline").value]);setOpts("groupDistance",GROUP_DISTANCES[$("groupDiscipline").value]);renderGroup()}
function updateGroup(id,i,v){let c=groupCard($("groupDiscipline").value,$("groupClass").value,$("groupDistance").value,id);c.groups[i]=v===""?null:Number(v);save();renderGroup();renderResults()}
function updateGroupPenalty(id,i,v){let c=groupCard($("groupDiscipline").value,$("groupClass").value,$("groupDistance").value,id);c.moaPenalty[i]=Math.max(0,Number(v)||0);save();renderGroup();renderResults()}
function renderGroup(){
let discipline=$("groupDiscipline").value,category=$("groupCategory").value,cls=$("groupClass").value,distance=$("groupDistance").value,detail=$("groupDetail").value;
const cardCount=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(db.groupCardsToday)||5));
if($("groupCardsToday"))$("groupCardsToday").value=String(cardCount);
let shotCount=cls==="Experimental / Unlimited Benchrest"?10:5;
let shooters=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category).sort((a,b)=>detailName(a.detailId).localeCompare(detailName(b.detailId))||a.bench-b.bench);
$("groupTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card">
<div class="detail-head">
<div>
<h3>${cardCount}-Card Group Shoot</h3>
<p class="muted"><b>${esc(category)}</b> • ${esc(cls)} • ${esc(distance)} • ${shotCount}-shot groups</p>
</div>
<span class="pill">${cardCount} card${cardCount===1?"":"s"} count toward Total Agg</span>
</div>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin:10px 0 14px">
${cardCount===1
? "Only Group 1 is used for the Total Agg."
: `Groups 1–${cardCount} are used for the Total Agg. Any later groups are ignored for today's result.`}
</div>
<div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Shooter</th>${Array.from({length:cardCount},(_,i)=>`<th>Group ${i+1}<br><span class="small">inches / MOA penalty</span></th>`).join("")}<th>Total Agg</th></tr></thead><tbody>
${shooters.map(s=>{
let c=groupCard(discipline,cls,distance,s.id);
let entered=c.groups.slice(0,cardCount).filter(v=>v!==null&&v!=="").length;
let agg=groupAgg(distance,c,cardCount);
return `<tr>
<td>${esc(detailName(s.detailId))}</td>
<td>${s.bench}</td>
<td>${esc(s.name)}</td>
${c.groups.slice(0,cardCount).map((v,i)=>`<td><input class="groupinput" type="number" min="0" step="0.001" value="${v??""}" placeholder="Group" onchange="updateGroup('${s.id}',${i},this.value)"><input class="groupinput" type="number" min="0" step="1" value="${c.moaPenalty[i]||0}" onchange="updateGroupPenalty('${s.id}',${i},this.value)"></td>`).join("")}
<td>${agg===null
? `<span class="pill warn">${entered}/${cardCount} entered</span>`
: `<div class="bigscore">${agg.toFixed(4)}</div><div class="small muted">${cardCount}-card Total Agg</div>`}
</td>
</tr>`
}).join("")||`<tr><td colspan="${4+cardCount}" class="empty">No shooters.</td></tr>`}
</tbody></table></div>
</div>`;
}
/* IRB */
function irbData(id){if(!db.irb[id])db.irb[id]={targets:[]};let d=db.irb[id];while(d.targets.length<6)d.targets.push({bulls:Array(25).fill(null),penalty:0});for(let t of d.targets){while(t.bulls.length<25)t.bulls.push(null);t.bulls=t.bulls.slice(0,25);t.penalty=Number(t.penalty||0)}return d}
function irbParse(v){if(v==="X")return {p:10,x:1};if(v===null||v==="")return {p:null,x:0};return {p:Number(v),x:0}}
function irbTargetStats(t){let points=0,x=0,counts={10:0,9:0,8:0,7:0,6:0,5:0,4:0,3:0},sequence=[],filled=0;for(const v of t.bulls){let q=irbParse(v);sequence.push(q.p===null?-1:q.p+(q.x?.1:0));if(q.p!==null){points+=q.p;x+=q.x;filled++;if(q.p>=3)counts[q.p]=(counts[q.p]||0)+1}}points=Math.max(0,points-Number(t.penalty||0));return {points,x,counts,sequence,complete:filled===25}}
function irbMatchStats(id){let d=irbData(id),total=0,x=0,counts={10:0,9:0,8:0,7:0,6:0,5:0,4:0,3:0},sequence=[],complete=true,targets=[];for(let i=0;i<db.irbTargets;i++){let s=irbTargetStats(d.targets[i]);targets.push(s);total+=s.points;x+=s.x;complete=complete&&s.complete;sequence.push(...s.sequence);Object.keys(counts).forEach(k=>counts[k]+=s.counts[k]||0)}return {total,x,counts,sequence,complete,targets}}
function irbOptions(v){return ["","X","10","9","8","7","6","5","4","3","0"].map(x=>`<option value="${x}" ${String(v??"")===x?"selected":""}>${x||"—"}</option>`).join("")}
function populateIRBShooters(){let category=$("irbCategory").value,detail=$("irbDetail").value,shooters=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category).sort((a,b)=>detailName(a.detailId).localeCompare(detailName(b.detailId))||a.bench-b.bench),e=$("irbShooter"),old=e.value;e.innerHTML=shooters.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">Bench ${s.bench} — ${esc(s.name)}</option>`).join("")||'<option value="">No shooters</option>';if(shooters.some(s=>s.id===old))e.value=old;populateIRBTargets();renderIRB()}
function populateIRBTargets(){
db.irbTargets=Math.max(1,Math.min(6,Number(db.irbCardsToday||db.irbTargets)||3));
let e=$("irbTarget"),old=Number(e.value||1);
e.innerHTML=Array.from({length:db.irbTargets},(_,i)=>`<option value="${i+1}">Card ${i+1}</option>`).join("");
e.value=String(Math.min(old,db.irbTargets));
if($("irbCardsToday"))$("irbCardsToday").value=String(db.irbTargets);
}
function setIRBCardsToday(v){
db.irbCardsToday=Math.max(1,Math.min(6,Number(v)||3));
db.irbTargets=db.irbCardsToday;
save();
populateIRBTargets();
renderIRB();
renderResults();
}
function updateIRBBull(i,v){let id=$("irbShooter").value;if(!id)return;let t=irbData(id).targets[Number($("irbTarget").value)-1];t.bulls[i]=v===""?null:v;save();renderIRB();renderResults()}
function updateIRBPenalty(v){let id=$("irbShooter").value;if(!id)return;irbData(id).targets[Number($("irbTarget").value)-1].penalty=Math.max(0,Number(v)||0);save();renderIRB();renderResults()}
function previousIRB(){let e=$("irbTarget"),v=Number(e.value);if(v>1){e.value=String(v-1);renderIRB()}}
function nextIRB(){let e=$("irbTarget"),v=Number(e.value);if(v<db.irbTargets){e.value=String(v+1);renderIRB()}}
function renderIRB(){let id=$("irbShooter").value;if(!id){$("irbGrid").innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">Add/select a shooter.</div>';$("irbTitle").textContent="";$("irbScore").textContent="";$("irbX").textContent="";$("irbSummary").innerHTML="";return}let idx=Number($("irbTarget").value||1)-1,t=irbData(id).targets[idx],st=irbTargetStats(t),m=irbMatchStats(id);$("irbTitle").textContent=`Card ${idx+1} of ${db.irbTargets}`;$("irbScore").textContent=`${st.points}/250`;$("irbX").textContent=`${st.x}/25 X`;$("irbPenalty").value=t.penalty||0;$("irbGrid").innerHTML=t.bulls.map((v,i)=>`<div class="bull"><label>Bull ${i+1}</label><select onchange="updateIRBBull(${i},this.value)">${irbOptions(v)}</select></div>`).join("");$("irbSummary").innerHTML=`<div class="score-summary"><span class="bigscore">${m.total}/${db.irbTargets*250}</span><span>${m.x}/${db.irbTargets*25} X</span><span class="pill ${m.complete?"good":"warn"}">${m.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</span></div><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Target</th><th>Score</th><th>X</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${m.targets.map((x,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${x.points}/250</td><td>${x.x}</td><td>${x.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div>`}
/* RESULTS */
function resultTypeChanged(){
let type=$("resultType").value;
const isIRB=type==="irb", isScoreGrand=type==="scoregrand", isGroupMode=(type==="group"||type==="grand");
$("resultDisciplineWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",isIRB);
$("resultCategoryWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",!(isGroupMode||isIRB));
$("resultClassWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",isIRB);
$("resultDistanceWrap").classList.toggle("hidden",isIRB||isScoreGrand);
if($("resultClassLabel"))$("resultClassLabel").textContent=(type==="score"||isScoreGrand)?"Category":"Class";
if(isIRB)renderResults();
else resultDisciplineChanged();
}
function resultDisciplineChanged(){
let type=$("resultType").value,d=$("resultDiscipline").value;
if(type==="score"||type==="scoregrand"){
setOpts("resultClass",SCORE_CLASSES[d]);
if(type==="score")setOpts("resultDistance",["Overall",...SCORE_DISTANCES[d]]);
}else{
setOpts("resultClass",GROUP_CLASSES[d]);
if(type==="grand")setOpts("resultDistance",GROUP_DISTANCES[d]);
else setOpts("resultDistance",["Overall",...GROUP_DISTANCES[d]]);
}
renderResults();
}
function lexCompare(a,b){for(let i=0;i<Math.max(a.length,b.length);i++){let av=a[i]??-1,bv=b[i]??-1;if(av!==bv)return bv-av}return 0}
function renderResults(){let type=$("resultType").value;if(type==="score")renderScoreResults();else if(type==="scoregrand")renderScoreGrandResults();else if(type==="group")renderGroupResults();else if(type==="grand")renderGrandAggregate();else renderIRBResults()}
function renderScoreResults(){
let d=$("resultDiscipline").value,cls=$("resultClass").value,dist=$("resultDistance").value,detail=$("resultDetail").value,distances=dist==="Overall"?SCORE_DISTANCES[d]:[dist];
let rows=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===cls).map(s=>{let points=0,x=0,counts={10:0,9:0,8:0,7:0,6:0},seq=[],complete=true;for(const dd of distances){let st=scoreStats(scoreCard(d,cls,dd,s.id));points+=st.points;x+=st.x;complete=complete&&st.complete;seq.push(...st.sequence);Object.keys(counts).forEach(k=>counts[k]+=st.counts[k]||0)}return {s,points,x,counts,seq,complete}}).sort((a,b)=>{if(a.points!==b.points)return b.points-a.points;if(a.x!==b.x)return b.x-a.x;for(const n of [10,9,8,7,6])if(a.counts[n]!==b.counts[n])return b.counts[n]-a.counts[n];return lexCompare(a.seq,b.seq)||a.s.bench-b.s.bench});
let max=distances.length*db.scoreCardsToday*50,maxX=distances.length*db.scoreCardsToday*5;
$("resultsTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card"><h3>Benchrest for Score • ${esc(d)} • ${esc(cls)} • ${esc(dist)}</h3><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Pos</th><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th><th>Score</th><th>X</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td><b>${i+1}</b></td><td>${esc(detailName(r.s.detailId))}</td><td>${r.s.bench}</td><td>${esc(r.s.name)}</td><td><b>${r.points}/${max}</b></td><td>${r.x}/${maxX}</td><td><span class="pill ${r.complete?"good":"warn"}">${r.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</span></td></tr>`).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">No shooters.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`
}
function renderScoreGrandResults(){
const discipline=$("resultDiscipline").value;
const category=$("resultClass").value;
const detail=$("resultDetail").value;
const distances=SCORE_DISTANCES[discipline];
let rows=db.shooters
.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category)
.map(s=>{
const first=scoreStats(scoreCard(discipline,category,distances[0],s.id));
const second=scoreStats(scoreCard(discipline,category,distances[1],s.id));
const complete=first.complete&&second.complete;
const total=first.points+second.points;
const x=first.x+second.x;
const counts={10:0,9:0,8:0,7:0,6:0};
[first,second].forEach(st=>Object.keys(counts).forEach(k=>counts[k]+=st.counts[k]||0));
const sequence=[...first.sequence,...second.sequence];
return {s,first,second,complete,total,x,counts,sequence};
})
.sort((a,b)=>{
if(a.complete!==b.complete)return a.complete?-1:1;
if(a.total!==b.total)return b.total-a.total;
if(a.x!==b.x)return b.x-a.x;
for(const n of [10,9,8,7,6])if(a.counts[n]!==b.counts[n])return b.counts[n]-a.counts[n];
return lexCompare(a.sequence,b.sequence)||Number(a.s.bench||999)-Number(b.s.bench||999);
});
$("resultsTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card">
<div class="detail-head">
<div>
<h3>Score Grand Total • ${esc(discipline)} • ${esc(category)}</h3>
<p class="muted">${esc(distances[0])} + ${esc(distances[1])}</p>
</div>
<span class="pill">Max ${db.scoreCardsToday*100} + ${db.scoreCardsToday*10}X</span>
</div>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin:12px 0">
The two selected distance totals are added together. With ${db.scoreCardsToday} card${db.scoreCardsToday===1?"":"s"} per distance, the maximum is <b>${db.scoreCardsToday*100} points + ${db.scoreCardsToday*10}X</b>. Both distances must be complete.
</div>
<div class="tablewrap"><table>
<thead><tr><th>Pos</th><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th><th>${esc(distances[0])}</th><th>${esc(distances[1])}</th><th>Grand Total</th><th>X</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr>
<td><b>${r.complete?i+1:"—"}</b></td>
<td>${esc(detailName(r.s.detailId))}</td>
<td>${r.s.bench||"—"}</td>
<td>${esc(r.s.name)}</td>
<td>${r.first.points}/${db.scoreCardsToday*50} • ${r.first.x}X</td>
<td>${r.second.points}/${db.scoreCardsToday*50} • ${r.second.x}X</td>
<td><b>${r.complete?r.total+"/"+(db.scoreCardsToday*100):"—"}</b></td>
<td>${r.complete?r.x+"/"+(db.scoreCardsToday*10):"—"}</td>
<td><span class="pill ${r.complete?"good":"warn"}">${r.complete?"Complete":"Needs both distances"}</span></td>
</tr>`).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="9" class="empty">No shooters in this category.</td></tr>'}
</tbody>
</table></div>
</div>`;
}
function renderGroupResults(){
let d=$("resultDiscipline").value,category=$("resultCategory").value,cls=$("resultClass").value,dist=$("resultDistance").value,detail=$("resultDetail").value,distances=dist==="Overall"?GROUP_DISTANCES[d].slice(0,2):[dist];
let rows=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category).map(s=>{let aggs=distances.map(dd=>groupAgg(dd,groupCard(d,cls,dd,s.id))),complete=aggs.every(x=>x!==null),agg=complete?aggs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/aggs.length:null,small=[];if(complete)for(const dd of distances)small.push(Math.min(...groupCard(d,cls,dd,s.id).groups.slice(0,db.groupCardsToday).map(Number)));return {s,complete,agg,small}}).sort((a,b)=>{if(a.complete!==b.complete)return a.complete?-1:1;if(a.complete&&b.complete){if(a.agg!==b.agg)return a.agg-b.agg;let aa=a.small.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/a.small.length,bb=b.small.reduce((x,y)=>x+y,0)/b.small.length;if(aa!==bb)return aa-bb}return a.s.bench-b.s.bench});
$("resultsTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card"><h3>${dist==="Overall"?"Overall Class Aggregate":"Group"} • ${esc(d)} • ${esc(category)} • ${esc(cls)} • ${esc(dist)}</h3><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Pos</th><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th><th>Aggregate MOA</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td><b>${r.complete?i+1:"—"}</b></td><td>${esc(detailName(r.s.detailId))}</td><td>${r.s.bench}</td><td>${esc(r.s.name)}</td><td><b>${r.agg===null?"—":r.agg.toFixed(4)}</b></td><td><span class="pill ${r.complete?"good":"warn"}">${r.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</span></td></tr>`).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">No shooters.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`
}
function groupCardHasData(card,count=db.groupCardsToday||5){
const n=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(count)||5));
return card.groups.slice(0,n).some(v=>v!==null&&v!=="");
}
function groupClassProgressForShooter(shooterId,discipline,cls){
const distances=discipline==="Rimfire"?["50 metres","100 yards"]:["100 yards","200 yards"];
const status=distances.map(dist=>{
const card=groupCard(discipline,cls,dist,shooterId);
const agg=groupAgg(dist,card);
return {dist,card,started:groupCardHasData(card),complete:agg!==null,agg};
});
return {distances,status,started:status.some(x=>x.started),complete:status.every(x=>x.complete)};
}
function groupOverallStatsForShooter(shooterId,discipline,cls){
const distances=discipline==="Rimfire"?["50 metres","100 yards"]:["100 yards","200 yards"];
const aggs=[];
const smallest=[];
for(const dist of distances){
const card=groupCard(discipline,cls,dist,shooterId);
const agg=groupAgg(dist,card);
if(agg===null)return {complete:false,overall:null,smallest:null,distances};
aggs.push(agg);
smallest.push(Math.min(...card.groups.slice(0,db.groupCardsToday).map(Number)));
}
return {
complete:true,
overall:aggs.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/aggs.length,
smallest:smallest.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/smallest.length,
distances
};
}
function grandAggregateClassesFired(discipline){
return GROUP_CLASSES[discipline].filter(cls =>
db.shooters.some(s => groupClassProgressForShooter(s.id,discipline,cls).started)
);
}
function renderGrandAggregate(){
const discipline=$("resultDiscipline").value;
const category=$("resultCategory").value;
const cls=$("resultClass").value;
const distance=$("resultDistance").value;
const detail=$("resultDetail").value;
const cardCount=Math.max(1,Math.min(5,Number(db.groupCardsToday)||5));
let rows=db.shooters
.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category)
.map(s=>{
const card=groupCard(discipline,cls,distance,s.id);
const values=card.groups.slice(0,cardCount);
const entered=values.filter(v=>v!==null&&v!=="").length;
const agg=groupAgg(distance,card,cardCount);
return {s,card,values,entered,complete:agg!==null,agg};
})
.sort((a,b)=>{
if(a.complete!==b.complete)return a.complete?-1:1;
if(a.complete&&b.complete){
if(a.agg!==b.agg)return a.agg-b.agg;
const aSmall=Math.min(...a.values.map(Number));
const bSmall=Math.min(...b.values.map(Number));
if(aSmall!==bSmall)return aSmall-bSmall;
}
return Number(a.s.bench||999)-Number(b.s.bench||999);
});
const groupHeaders=Array.from({length:cardCount},(_,i)=>`<th>Group ${i+1}</th>`).join("");
$("resultsTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card">
<div class="detail-head">
<div>
<h3>${cardCount}-Card Total Aggregate • ${esc(discipline)} • ${esc(category)}</h3>
<p class="muted">${esc(cls)} • ${esc(distance)} • ${cardCount} group${cardCount===1?"":"s"} being shot today</p>
</div>
<span class="pill">${cardCount} group${cardCount===1?"":"s"}</span>
</div>
<div class="rulebox" style="margin:12px 0">
<b>Total Aggregate</b> is calculated from all ${cardCount} Group card${cardCount===1?"":"s"} selected for today.
${distance==="50 metres"
? `For 50 metres: the ${cardCount} group measurements are added, doubled, then divided by ${cardCount}.`
: distance==="100 yards"
? `For 100 yards: the ${cardCount} group measurements are added and divided by ${cardCount}.`
: distance==="200 yards"
? `For 200 yards: the ${cardCount} group measurements are added and divided by ${cardCount*2}.`
: `For 300 yards: the ${cardCount} group measurements are added and divided by ${cardCount*3}.`}
<b>Lowest Total Aggregate wins.</b>
</div>
<div class="tablewrap"><table>
<thead><tr><th>Pos</th><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th>${groupHeaders}<th>${cardCount}-Card Total Agg</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr>
<td><b>${r.complete?i+1:"—"}</b></td>
<td>${esc(detailName(r.s.detailId))}</td>
<td>${r.s.bench||"—"}</td>
<td>${esc(r.s.name)}</td>
${r.values.map(v=>`<td>${v===null||v===""?"—":Number(v).toFixed(3)}</td>`).join("")}
<td><b>${r.complete?r.agg.toFixed(4):"—"}</b></td>
<td><span class="pill ${r.complete?"good":"warn"}">${r.complete?"Complete":`${r.entered}/${cardCount} entered`}</span></td>
</tr>`).join("")||`<tr><td colspan="${6+cardCount}" class="empty">No shooters in this category.</td></tr>`}
</tbody>
</table></div>
</div>`;
}
function renderIRBResults(){
let category=$("resultCategory").value,detail=$("resultDetail").value,rows=db.shooters.filter(s=>(detail==="all"||s.detailId===detail)&&(s.category||"Custom")===category).map(s=>({s,...irbMatchStats(s.id)})).sort((a,b)=>{if(a.total!==b.total)return b.total-a.total;if(a.x!==b.x)return b.x-a.x;for(const n of [10,9,8,7,6,5,4,3])if(a.counts[n]!==b.counts[n])return b.counts[n]-a.counts[n];return lexCompare(a.sequence,b.sequence)||a.s.bench-b.s.bench});
$("resultsTable").innerHTML=`<div class="card section-card"><h3>IRB • ${esc(category)} • 50 metres • ${db.irbTargets} card${db.irbTargets===1?"":"s"}</h3><div class="tablewrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Pos</th><th>Detail</th><th>Bench</th><th>Name</th><th>Score</th><th>X</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((r,i)=>`<tr><td><b>${i+1}</b></td><td>${esc(detailName(r.s.detailId))}</td><td>${r.s.bench}</td><td>${esc(r.s.name)}</td><td><b>${r.total}/${db.irbTargets*250}</b></td><td>${r.x}</td><td><span class="pill ${r.complete?"good":"warn"}">${r.complete?"Complete":"In Progress"}</span></td></tr>`).join("")||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">No shooters.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`
}
/* DASHBOARD + APP */
function renderRecent(){
let complete=0,totalCards=0;
for(const k of Object.keys(db.score)){totalCards++;if(scoreStats(db.score[k]).complete)complete++}
for(const k of Object.keys(db.group)){let p=k.split("||");totalCards++;if(groupAgg(p[2],db.group[k])!==null)complete++}
for(const s of db.shooters){totalCards++;if(irbMatchStats(s.id).complete)complete++}
let status=(db.shooters.length&&totalCards&&complete===totalCards)?"Completed":"In Progress";
$("recentShootBody").innerHTML=`<tr>
<td>${esc(db.date||"—")}</td>
<td>${esc(db.shootName||"Narrabri Club Shoot")}</td>
<td>${db.shooters.length}</td>
<td><span class="pill ${status==="Completed"?"good":"warn"}">${status}</span></td>
<td><button class="btn-secondary" onclick="go('results')">View</button></td>
</tr>`
}
function populate(){
let ds=db.details.map(d=>`<option value="${d.id}">${esc(d.name)}</option>`).join("");
$("sDetail").innerHTML='<option value="unassigned">Bench Draw Pool (unassigned)</option>'+ds;
setOpts("sCategory",CATEGORIES);
setOpts("groupCategory",CATEGORIES);
setOpts("irbCategory",CATEGORIES);
setOpts("resultCategory",CATEGORIES);
for(const id of ["scoreDetail","groupDetail","irbDetail","resultDetail"])setDetails(id);
setOpts("scoreClass",SCORE_CLASSES[$("scoreDiscipline").value||"Rimfire"]);setOpts("scoreDistance",SCORE_DISTANCES[$("scoreDiscipline").value||"Rimfire"]);
if($("scoreCardsToday"))$("scoreCardsToday").value=String(db.scoreCardsToday||5);
setOpts("groupClass",GROUP_CLASSES[$("groupDiscipline").value||"Rimfire"]);setOpts("groupDistance",GROUP_DISTANCES[$("groupDiscipline").value||"Rimfire"]);
if($("groupCardsToday"))$("groupCardsToday").value=String(db.groupCardsToday||5);
populateScoreShooters();populateIRBShooters();resultTypeChanged()
}
function updateStats(){$("subtitle") && null}
function renderAll(){
$("club").value=db.club||"Narrabri";$("shootName").value=db.shootName||"Narrabri Club Shoot";$("date").value=db.date||"";
populate();renderDetails();renderShooters();renderBenchDraw();renderScore();renderGroup();renderIRB();renderResults();renderRecent()
}
function go(tab){
document.querySelectorAll(".tab").forEach(x=>x.classList.add("hidden"));$(tab).classList.remove("hidden");
document.querySelectorAll(".topnav button").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.tab===tab));
renderAll();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:"smooth"})
}
document.querySelectorAll(".topnav button").forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>go(b.dataset.tab));
function exportData(){let blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(db,null,2)],{type:"application/json"}),a=document.createElement("a");a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download="Narrabri-SSAA-shoot-data.json";a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)}
function importData(input){let f=input.files[0];if(!f)return;let r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{db=normalize(JSON.parse(r.result));save();renderAll();alert("Shoot data imported.")}catch(e){alert("Invalid shoot data file.")}};r.readAsText(f)}
go("home");
</script>
</body>
</html>
